title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
slides: Can a model built by AI code better?
Most of its pipeline was automated, not hand-written
You can audit and run it without cloud costs
Try one repo task locally this week
thread_text:
1. AI coding itself?

Recursive's Flint is a model built largely by AI, not hand-written. It targets coding tasks on a laptop, no cloud needed.

2. Laptop-scale coding

Most of Flint's pipeline was automated, meaning the model itself was assembled with minimal human coding. This raises the question: can AI-generated code outperform human-built models?

3. Audit without cloud

You can run and inspect Flint locally, avoiding cloud costs. That makes it accessible for individual developers and small teams.

4. Try it yourself

Pick a repo task this week and test Flint on your laptop. See if an AI-built model codes better than your usual tools.

5. Your move

Grab a small repo task and run Flint locally this week. Does it save time or create extra edits? Test it on real work.
